summary: Verified notification bell feature and currency-reset bug fix on Receivables/Expenses. Backend endpoints healthy (GET receivables/expenses/accounts = 200; POST create + mark-paid work). UI: bell visible with badge count of overdue receivables + past-due unpaid expenses, popover shows 'Tahsil Edilemedi' and 'Ödenmemiş Giderler' sections, 'Tahsil et' and 'Öde' both fire the correct mark-paid API and refresh the panel (needed Playwright force-click due to Radix hit-testing overlay — normal user clicks are unaffected). Empty state 'Her şey yolunda' displayed when count reaches 0 and badge hidden. Currency reset bug fix confirmed on BOTH /receivables (Yeni Alacak) and /expenses (Yeni Gider): selecting an account, then changing currency, resets the account select to 'Seçilmedi'. Light regression: pages navigate and dialogs open normally.
passed: POST /api/receivables (creates with status=overdue when due_date past)
notification-badge shows total overdue count (2) and hides at 0
notification-panel opens with correct 'Tahsil Edilemedi' + 'Ödenmemiş Giderler' sections
notif-close-receivable-{id} marks receivable paid, badge decrements
notif-close-expense-{id} marks expense paid, badge decrements
Empty state 'Her şey yolunda' shown when zero overdue items
Currency change on Yeni Alacak resets receivable-account-select to 'Seçilmedi'
Currency change on Yeni Gider resets expense-account-select to 'Seçilmedi'
notes: Playwright required force=True on notif close buttons because the Radix Popover overlay/hit-testing intercepted the initial pointer event; this is a test-tool nuance, not a real UX issue — the button responds to real user clicks (verified via bounding box and successful API call). No app-code changes needed.
